scope: Corollary 5.5 (The last guard law) of the manuscript “The Critical Spin Field of the Planar XY Model” (preprints/The-Critical-Spin-Field-of-the-Planar-XY-Model-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 486481fbcc54fe62), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 28. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For these fixed choices, the last-guard law in a nest of N annuli has density at most 2 relative to ms N for all sufficiently large N, in the centered sector and in either unit-period sector. The conclusion holds for identical lattice translates of the nest with the same threshold in N.
